author: P. Kyle McCarter Jr.

summary: Standard critical Anchor Bible commentary on 2 Samuel. On the Amalekite messenger's account in 2 Samuel 1:6-10 against 1 Samuel 31:3-5's own narration of Saul's death by his own sword, secondary sources consistently attribute to McCarter the observation that the text itself does not resolve whether David was taken in by the Amalekite's claim ('Whether David was deceived or not, we cannot tell') — treating the discrepancy as a real narrative tension the text leaves open rather than adjudicating it as either a confirmed fabrication or a genuine secondhand report.
